content.name: Kirra Donnelly
content.title: Administrative Assistant to the Directors
content.summary: Administrative assistant with nine years in reception, project administration and director support across health, construction and financial advice. Holds a Certificate IV in Business Administration and keeps compliance files audit-ready; most recently trimmed client onboarding time from ten days to six.

experience.title: Receptionist
bullets: Ran the front desk for six practitioners, booking around 300 sessions a week in Cliniko.
Processed HICAPS and Medicare claims at the counter and chased the small number of rejections the same day.
Set up SMS appointment reminders, which halved the number of empty slots caused by forgotten bookings.

experience.title: Administration Officer
bullets: Maintained induction records, White Card copies and licence expiry dates for 85 site workers in one register.
Prepared progress claim paperwork for project managers on jobs worth up to $4 million, matching dockets to the contract schedule.
Organised accommodation and travel for crews on regional jobs, keeping spend within the per-job allowance.
Answered tender document requests and tracked submission deadlines for 30-plus tenders a year.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant to the Directors
bullets: Support two directors and four advisers, managing diaries, client meeting packs and review reminders for 650 client households.
Redesigned the new-client onboarding checklist and document requests, bringing average onboarding from ten working days to six.
Keep fee consent and client file notes in order so that the last two compliance reviews found no missing records.
Coordinate client seminars of 40 to 80 guests, from venue booking to RSVP tracking and feedback forms.

achievements.title: Employee of the quarter
achievements.detail: Recognised by Moreton Bay Civil Contractors for keeping site compliance records current through a major audit.

achievements.title: Process champion
achievements.detail: Wrote the adviser team's procedures manual, now used to train every new starter.
